session_cue.text: Four eight-foot knight statues labeled Valor Piety Wisdom Duty

previous.text: The party hired Drop Dead Ned for the Barrow Mound, and Ned offered Wayman 5 gold per goblin body.
The party opened Sir Brandon's tomb, and Sir Phidipaldi took the dragon slayer's sword and armor.
Sir Phidipaldi planned to carry out Dunk's scheme for the mithril chain shirt once the sword was won.
Sir Phidipaldi's dragon plan called for getting poison protection from the witch or the alchemist.
Goblins and a talking slime warned the party of a mad undead giant who cut down goblins.
Sir Phidipaldi, posing as Brandon's son, struck a bargain with the Free Goblin Society in the Barrow Mound.

current.where_you_are: The party is inside Sir Brandon's tomb in the Barrow Mound, ready to leave.

immediate_danger.text: A seven-foot undead brown skeleton stands in the tomb's doorway. It wears rusted armor and a mustachioed death mask, and it drags a huge greatsword. The goblins say it killed many of their friends, and the slime says it is very mad.

Your goals.text: Kill the dragon near Brandonsford for Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold bounty.
Obtain protection against the black dragon's poison before going after the dragon.
Find the treasure marked on the party's map.

Standing in your way.text: The undead giant swordsman who killed many goblins stands in the way of clearing the evil from the Barrow Mound.
George says nothing pierces the black dragon's scales. Arrows and swords have all failed against them.
The Free Goblin Society would not want their dead defiled. Giving the goblin bodies to Ned means sneaking them past the goblins.

What could help.text: Sir Phidipaldi holds Sir Brandon's magical, uncursed sword, etched "All shadows yield to my light". Father William says only this sword can kill the dragon.
The party holds a jeweled ceremonial dagger, seven 50-gold candleholders, a 20-gold gold-toothed skull and five 100-gold urns. Dr. Uriah values the dagger at over 200 gold in a major city.
Drop Dead Ned, the inn's killer with a little killer wasp, scouts and kills for the party in the Barrow Mound for a 100 gold fee.

Still unanswered.text: Is the undead giant swordsman Alfred, Sir Brandon's shaggy companion with a greatsword in the mosaics?
Do the robes of Saint Arthur have magical properties? Dr. Uriah judged them uncursed but needs Ingrid's witch powder to test them.
Brother Dirk says the jeweled chalice was surely a gift to the church. Does it belong to the church, and will the party give it up?
Where did the new dragon near Brandonsford come from?
Why have shipments stopped reaching Brandonsford?

Promises and debts.text: The party must clear the evil out of the Barrow Mound for the Free Goblin Society. In return, the goblins live there and let the party take Sir Brandon's goods.
Dunk must help Ingrid get into Warwick's house and give Warwick the sleeping potion.
Dr. Uriah must do penance at the Barrow Mound for Father William.
The party must let Squints pick second from the Barrow Mound treasure, after the elite members.
Dr. Uriah must give Father William a 10 gold donation for the Barrow Mound's upkeep.

Meanwhile.text: George says the black dragon will soon fly and doom Brandonsford.

threads.name: Treasure map
threads.note: Not touched this Session; the Barrow Mound treasure is not tied to the map.

threads.name: Dragon hunt (Eric the Reeve's bounty)
threads.note: Sir Phidipaldi took Sir Brandon's magic sword (beat_61) and the party set out a plan, but the dragon still lives, so the hunt continues with an added resource.

threads.name: Fairies appearing more often
threads.note: Not touched this Session; the myth of a fairy-given sword does not explain why fairies are appearing.

threads.name: Ingrid and Warwick (Dunk's deal)
threads.note: The party plans to carry out Dunk's scheme with Ingrid after the Barrow, but it has not been done.

threads.name: Dr. Uriah's penance for Father William
threads.note: Dr. Uriah reached the Barrow Mound but did no penance and made no donation; still owed.

threads.name: Squints' share of the treasure
threads.note: The party gathered its first treasure, but Squints has not yet made his promised second pick.

threads.name: Drop Dead Ned's hire
threads.note: The party hired Ned under an ongoing arrangement paying them for murders and bodies, and he has offered a deal on the goblin corpses that would need sneaking past the goblins.

threads.name: Protection against the black dragon's poison
threads.note: Sir Phidipaldi's plan states that protection from the witch or alchemist is needed because the black dragon is poisonous, so it serves the dragon hunt.

threads.name: The Free Goblin Society bargain
threads.note: The party promised to clear the evil from the mound and keep the goblins' presence from King Hogboon in return for their home there; the evil is not yet cleared.

threads.name: The undead giant in the Barrow Mound
threads.note: A huge undead swordsman, apparently one of Brandon's companions, has killed many goblins and has just appeared in the tomb doorway (beat_62); the danger is live.

threads.name: The robes of Saint Arthur
threads.note: Dr. Uriah wears the holy robes untested for magic, over Brother Dirk's deep offense; both the robes' nature and Dirk's grievance remain open.

threads.name: The noblewoman statue
threads.note: The riddle was answered, but whom the speaking noblewoman statue depicts remains an unanswered question.

threads.name: Brother Dirk's claim on the chalice
threads.note: Dirk suggested the jeweled chalice belongs to the church and Trout deferred the question until later.

facts.text: Find the treasure marked on the party's map.
Kill the dragon near Brandonsford for Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold bounty.
George says nothing pierces the black dragon's scales; arrows and swords have all failed against them.
George says the black dragon will soon fly and doom Brandonsford.
Lady Hilda will join the party against the dragon if they pay her.
Sir Phidipaldi holds Sir Brandon's magical, uncursed sword of silvery white metal etched "All shadows yield to my light"; Father William says only this sword can kill the dragon.
Warwick keeps a magical mithril chain shirt; Dunk says it could help against the dragon.
Where did the new dragon near Brandonsford come from?
Sir Phidipaldi's plan: show Sir Brandon's sword to Eric the Reeve as proof of competence to strong-arm him into an advance on the bounty, then use the advance to pay Lady Hilda and henchmen.
The Barrow Mound mosaics show Sir Brandon slaying the old dragon by driving his sword up through the roof of its open mouth.
Why have shipments stopped reaching Brandonsford?
Why are hidden fairies coming out more often along with the dragon?
Dunk must help Ingrid get into Warwick's house and give Warwick the sleeping potion.
Dr. Uriah must do penance at the Barrow Mound for Father William.
Dr. Uriah must give Father William a 10 gold donation for the Barrow Mound's upkeep.
The party must let Squints pick second from the first treasure, after the elite members. That treasure has now been gathered in the Barrow Mound, but Squints has not yet made his pick.

From the Barrow Mound the party holds a jewel-encrusted ceremonial dagger (Dr. Uriah values it at upwards of 200 gold in a major city), seven gold candleholders worth 50 gold each, a skull with gold teeth worth 20 gold and five urns worth 100 gold each.
Drop Dead Ned, the inn's killer who carries a little killer wasp, is hired by the party for a 100 gold fee and accompanies them in the Barrow Mound as a scout and killer.
Ned pays the party 10 gold each time they let him murder somebody, provided he can do whatever he wants with the body.
Ned offers 5 gold per goblin body for the three dead goblins in the Barrow Mound's lower corridor, if the party gives him the bodies.
The Free Goblin Society goblins would not want their dead compatriots defiled, so giving the goblin bodies to Ned means sneaking them past the goblins.
Obtain protection against the black dragon's poison before going after the dragon.
Sir Phidipaldi's plan is to get the poison protection from the witch or the alchemist once the party returns to town; the cost and whether either can provide it are not yet known.
The party promised the Free Goblin Society to clear the evil out of the Barrow Mound, in return for the goblins living there and letting the party take Sir Brandon's goods.
The party promised the Free Goblin Society never to tell King Hogboon that the goblins are settled in the Barrow Mound.
The undead giant swordsman who killed many of the goblins stands in the way of clearing the evil from the Barrow Mound.
What is making the scratching sounds at the far west end of the mound's lower hunters' corridor?

A seven-foot undead brown skeleton in rusted armor and a mustachioed death mask, dragging a huge greatsword, has appeared in the doorway of Sir Brandon's tomb as the party prepares to leave. The goblins say it is one of the mosaic figures, still alive, and that it killed many of their friends; the slime says it is undead and very mad.
Is the undead giant swordsman Alfred, the shaggy giant with a greatsword who was Sir Brandon's companion in the mosaics?
Do the robes of Saint Arthur have any magical properties? Dr. Uriah judged them not cursed but could not test them without Ingrid's witch powder, and wearing them had no notable effect.
Dr. Uriah wears the robes of Saint Arthur and carries the quarterstaff found with them. Brother Dirk says the robes are far too holy to wear and is deeply offended that Uriah wears them.

Whom does the stone noblewoman statue before Sir Brandon's tomb depict, and whose female voice asked the party "What makes a true knight?" Brother Dirk does not know, and the mosaics show neither Wyllt nor Myrddin as a woman.
Trout holds the jeweled chalice taken from Sir Brandon's tomb, worth 600 gold.
Brother Dirk suggests the jeweled chalice was surely a gift to the church. Does it belong to the church, and will the party give it up? Trout deferred the question until later.
